description: Re-score a site on the Index after it ships changes for agents: fresh probes, then about 24 agent sessions over a few minutes. Owner only (whoever claimed it, a work email on that domain while unclaimed, or a platform admin), once every 10 minutes. Poll list_index_sessions with the run_id about every 60 seconds, then read get_index_report.

domain.description: The site to read, e.g. "example.com". A full URL is fine: protocol, path and a leading www. are dropped. Pass this or project_id, not both.

project_id.description: Project UUID, from list_projects. Uses the Index domain linked to that project instead of naming one; fails if the project has no linked domain. Pass this or domain, not both.

name: request_index_rerun

agent_sessions.description: enqueued when the agent sessions started; anything else (failed, off) means only the probes refreshed.

message.description: What happened and what to do next, ready to relay.

report_url.description: The public Index report page for the site, to link a person to.

run_id.description: The new scoring run. Pass it to list_index_sessions to follow progress.

title: Request Index re-run
